text:
Riley (People Ops): quick question — new hire Sam W (emp 99872) just had our vendor migration but their beneficiary designation didn't carry over to Prism. also they went from PT -> FT on 02/10. can payroll confirm vesting service count and whether catch-up eligibility should be enabled?
Jamie - Payroll: got it. emp 99872 — can you confirm last 4 of SSN? also which beneficiary form did they have on file (pdf or portal)?
Riley (People Ops): last4 4321. had a scanned PDF submitted in 2022 via old vendor. i uploaded it to the hr drive: https://go/repo/hr/forms/99872_benef.pdf
PeopleOps Bot: Reminder: employees must submit beneficiary via Prism portal for it to be the active record after migration. Automated sync runs nightly; manual uploads are stored as attachments only.
Ben - Benefits Vendor: hi all — we can't accept scanned PDFs as canonical after cutover. Riley please have Sam create (or we can create a temporary record) in Prism and confirm email used. sync window for manual reconciliation is 7 business days.
Jamie - Payroll: on the PT->FT change: our system counts service months for vesting. PT months count pro rata based on FTE%. Sam's records show 18 months continuous service at 0.6 FTE prior to 02/10, then 1.0 FTE after. i'll run the vesting calc and post numbers.
Alex P: small question on catch-up: Sam just turned 50 last week — do we enable catch-up immediately or wait til next payroll year?
Riley (People Ops): i thought catch-up is available the calendar year the employee turns 50? want to confirm so payroll turns the flag on.
Ben - Benefits Vendor: correct — catch-up (age 50+) is allowed for the calendar year the employee turns 50. Prism requires us to mark the plan election; payroll needs to pass the catch-up contribution code (CCUP) on the file.
Jamie - Payroll: confirming action items: 1) Riley get Sam to re-enter beneficiary in Prism (or provide vendor-signed form) 2) payroll will run vesting calc and confirm employer match vested % by EOD 2501234589 3) if Sam wants catch-up, send election form and we'll set CCUP for next payroll cycle.
Riley (People Ops): i'll loop Sam in and ask them to finish portal sign-up. if they want, Ben can create temp record today so there isn't a 7-day exposure. @Ben is that possible?
Ben - Benefits Vendor: yes we can create a temporary beneficiary record on our side and flag it for review once Sam confirms in portal. please DM me the employee email.
Alex P: thanks all — one more: does vesting change retroactively when PT months convert pro rata? Jamie pls include the formula you use so I can add to the FAQ.
Jamie - Payroll: formula: vested_months = sum_over_periods(months * FTE_fraction). example: 18 months @0.6 = 10.8 -> round down to 10 full months for vesting schedule. i'll paste the calc in the thread once i run it.
Riley (People Ops): perfect. i'll message Sam and close the loop. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
PeopleOps Bot: Action items created: #task-99872-beneficiary-recon, #task-99872-vest-calc.
